sentences.text: Kuching -LSB- ˈkuːtʃɪŋ -RSB- -LRB- Jawi : , -RRB- , officially the City of Kuching , is the capital and the most populous city in the state of Sarawak in Malaysia .	City	List of cities in Malaysia	Jawi	Jawi script	state	States and federal territories of Malaysia	Sarawak	Sarawak	Malaysia	Malaysia
It is also the capital of Kuching Division .	Kuching Division	Kuching Division

The city is situated on the Sarawak River at the southwest tip of the state of Sarawak on the island of Borneo and covers an area of 431 km2 with a population about 165,642 in the Kuching North administrative region and 159,490 in the Kuching South administrative regiona total of 325,132 people .	state	States and federal territories of Malaysia	Sarawak	Sarawak	Sarawak River	Sarawak River	Borneo	Borneo
Kuching was the third capital of Sarawak in 1827 during the administration of the Bruneian Empire .	Sarawak	Sarawak	Bruneian Empire	Bruneian Empire

In 1841 , Kuching became the capital of Sarawak after Sarawak was ceded to James Brooke for helping the Bruneian empire in crushing a rebellion particularly the interior borneo dweller Dayak people who later became his loyal followers .	James Brooke	James Brooke	Sarawak	Sarawak	Dayak people	Dayak people

The town continued to receive attention and development during the rule of Charles Brooke such as the construction of a sanitation system , hospital , prison , fort , and a bazaar .	Charles Brooke	Charles Brooke, Rajah of Sarawak
In 1941 , the Brooke administration had a Centenary Celebration in Kuching .
During World War II , Kuching was occupied by Japanese forces from 1942 to 1945 .	World War II	World War II
The Japanese government set up a Batu Lintang camp near Kuching to hold prisoners of war and civilian internees .	Batu Lintang camp	Batu Lintang camp
After the war , the town survived intact .

However , the last Rajah of Sarawak , Sir Charles Vyner Brooke decided to cede Sarawak as part of British Crown Colony in 1946 .	Sarawak	Sarawak	Sir Charles Vyner Brooke	Charles Vyner Brooke	as part of British Crown Colony	Crown Colony of Sarawak
Kuching remained as capital during the Crown Colony period .
After the formation of Malaysia in 1963 , Kuching retained its status as state capital and was granted city status in 1988 .	state	States and federal territories of Malaysia	Malaysia	Malaysia
Since then , the Kuching city is divided into two administrative regions managed by two separate local authorities .

The administrative centre of Sarawak state government is located at Wisma Bapa Malaysia , Kuching .	state	States and federal territories of Malaysia	Sarawak	Sarawak	Malaysia	Malaysia	Wisma Bapa Malaysia	Wisma Bapa Malaysia
Kuching is a major food destination for tourists and the main gateway for travellers visiting Sarawak and Borneo .	Sarawak	Sarawak	Borneo	Borneo

Kuching Wetlands National Park is located about 30 km from the city and there are many other tourist attractions in and around Kuching such as Bako National Park , Semenggoh Wildlife Centre , Rainforest World Music Festival -LRB- RWMF -RRB- , state assembly building , The Astana , Fort Margherita , Kuching Cat Museum , and Sarawak State Museum .
